Skills we use to do research with AI assistants. A skill is a folder of instructions (a `SKILL.md` file) plus supporting materials that the assistant loads when a task calls for it.

Each entry shows **which assistants we have tested it in** (Claude, ChatGPT, Kimi…) and **what it is for**. Use the categories on the right to filter by task or by assistant.
